caseohwiki.name: CaseOh Wiki
caseohwiki.about: CaseOh a.k.a Case Baker is an American livestreamer and YouTuber known for creating content around playing a variety of games.

dantdmwiki.name: DanTDM Wiki
dantdmwiki.about: Daniel 'Robert' Middleton better known online as DanTDM, is a content creator on YouTube. He is best and commonly known for his Minecraft videos of Mod Showcases, Custom Mod Adventures, The Diamond Dimensions, etc.

jsalwiki.name: JackSucksAtLife Wiki
jsalwiki.about: Jack Massey Welsh is a English YouTuber. He is known for play button content, Reddit content on his second channel and even Geography content on his geography channel.

doughole.name: The Doug UNOFFICIAL Hole
doughole.about: The Doug UNOFFICIAL Hole, the DougDoug Encyclopedia purely dedicated to organizing and archiving DougDoug's unofficial channels and content. Here we have information about channels, events, fanart, and other things that should not be on the official wiki because they are not canon in the DougDoug Cinematic Universe.

osfirsttimer.name: OSFirstTimer Wiki
osfirsttimer.about: OSFirstTimer (Philip Adams) is a YouTube content creator for technology. He is known to let his mother to try out software and operating systems throughout the ages.
